# 1 Clement Chapter 61 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 61 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_061_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 61

*[The Great Prayer — Part III: Prayer for Rulers, Closing Doxology]*

**61:1** You, Master, have granted to them the power of sovereignty through your magnificent and indescribable dominion, so that we, acknowledging the glory and honor which you have conferred upon them, may be subject to them and in no way resist your will. Grant to them, Lord, health, peace, concord, and stability, that they may administer without offence the authority you have entrusted to them.

**61:2** For it is you, O heavenly Master, King of the ages, who give to the sons of men glory and honor and authority over the things upon earth. Direct, O Lord, their counsel according to what is good and acceptable in your sight, that they may exercise in peace and meekness and piety the authority given to them by you, and so obtain your mercy.

**61:3** O you who alone are able to do these things, and things far more excellent than these, for us — we give you praise through the High Priest and Advocate of our souls, Jesus Christ, through whom be glory and majesty to you, both now and unto all generations and for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with elevated liturgical register for the Great Prayer.*
